name: Spidermonkey
abilities: Steel-strong webbing fired from tail (traps, blinds, slingshots, nets)
Enhanced strength (carried Queen Rumbletum, knocked Ultimate Kevin airborne)
Prehensile tail and feet; four arms
Durable for his size (shrugged off falling concrete)
weaknesses: Can be tangled in his own webs; enemies turn them against him
Webs frozen brittle by Polar Manzardill breath or dissolved by Crystalsapien heat
Vulnerable to electricity, toxic gas and Argit's quills
Prey to Root Sharks and other Aranhascimmia predators
summary: A wisecracking blue four-armed monkey who slings steel-strong webbing from his tail; Ben's acrobat and the base of Ultimate Spidermonkey.
traits: Four eyes in AF/UA, six in OV
Fur oil keeps him from sticking to his own webs
notableFeats: Escaped the Omnitrix and fought Brainstorm (Vengeance of Vilgax: Part 2)
Fought Bivalvan before first going Ultimate (Fame)
Carried Queen Rumbletum to safety and fought General Attea (Tummy Trouble)
Rescued No Watch Ben from the evil Bens (And Then There Were None)

appearances.designNotes: Small blue-furred monkey with dark blue centre, four arms, four green eyes, three fingers/toes, striped tail; recalibrated Omnitrix symbol on chest.
Same design as Alien Force with the Ultimatrix symbol on chest. Heroes United cameo had fully black spider eyes with green pupils.

notableEpisodes: So Long, and Thanks for All the Smoothies
appearances.designNotes: Six green eyes, opposable toes, spiky flipped-up head fur with white stripes, white tail stripes, nose moved to forehead; Omnitrix on chest joined to two green sashes.

image.label: OV
image.notes: infobox OV render; small (307x307) but full-body - visually verified. Alternates: 'Pose of Spider Monkey.png', 'Ov Spider Monkey Transparent.png'

scoring.rationale: Mobility specialist (8): web-swinging, wall-crawling and acrobatics that outmanoeuvre most foes, with webbing strong enough to net Forever Knights and Incurseans. Light hitter who is usually the set-up for Ultimate Spidermonkey; his own webs and electricity are exploitable.

notes: Also used by Albedo (Negative Spidermonkey), the Naljian Destructor, Vilgax's Bioids and Time Heals Timeline Ben - no separate appearances.
Ben Prime showcased Spidermonkey to Ben 23 in Store 23 (still Ben Prime).
AF S1 (wiki) = ben-15-af, AF S2 = ben-16-af.
